segments.name: Commercial
segments.description: Develops, redevelops and manages commercial real estate assets located within qualified opportunity zones.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we have organized our operations into two reporting segments, commercial and mixed-use, based on the way we organize and evaluate our business internally.

segments.name: Mixed-use
segments.description: Develops and manages mixed-use real estate projects in qualified opportunity zones, including the Aster & Links and VIV properties.
segments.evidence: The increase in both rental revenues and property expenses relates to the continued stabilization of Aster & Links, which commenced lease-up June 30, 2024, as well as VIV, which commenced leasing activities in the fourth quarter of 2025.

revenueModel.text: The company earns rental revenue from tenants of its commercial and mixed-use real estate properties.
revenueModel.evidence: We calculate Segment NOI as rental revenue, less property expenses, excluding non-segment NOI ("Non-Segment NOI").
